functions.name: LL_USART_ConfigAsyncMode

params.name: USARTx
params.descZh: 串口实例指针，如 USART1 / USART2 / USART3。

functions.briefEn: Perform basic configuration of USART for enabling use in Asynchronous Mode (UART)
functions.briefZh: 把 USART 配置成标准异步模式（8 位数据、无校验、1 停止位、收发均使能）。
remarks: In UART mode, the following bits must be kept cleared: - LINEN bit in the USART_CR2 register, - CLKEN bit in the USART_CR2 register, - SCEN bit in the USART_CR3 register, - IREN bit in the USART_CR3 register, - HDSEL bit in the USART_CR3 register.

Call of this function is equivalent to following function call sequence : - Clear LINEN in CR2 using @ref LL_USART_DisableLIN() function - Clear CLKEN in CR2 using @ref LL_USART_DisableSCLKOutput() function - Clear SCEN in CR3 using @ref LL_USART_DisableSmartcard() function - Clear IREN in CR3 using @ref LL_USART_DisableIrda() function - Clear HDSEL in CR3 using @ref LL_USART_DisableHalfDuplex() function
Other remaining configurations items related to Asynchronous Mode (as Baud Rate, Word length, Parity, ...) should be set using dedicated functions

Other remaining configurations items related to Synchronous Mode (as Baud Rate, Word length, Parity, Clock Polarity, ...) should be set using dedicated functions
